summary.en-US: Native macOS Touch Bar controls for Firefox: compact navigation, Edge-style open tab scrubber with favicons, and YouTube/HTML5 media controls.

description.en-US:
IMPORTANT PREREQUISITE (macOS Only): This extension requires a MacBook Pro with a macOS Touch Bar and the open-source macOS companion helper (`touchbar-browser-helper`). Firefox WebExtensions cannot access the hardware Touch Bar directly without installing the local Native Messaging helper from the GitHub repository:
https://github.com/VisionCrizzal/touchbar-addon-new-FF

Features:
- Replaces Firefox's default Touch Bar with an Edge-style compact bar (with optional Full-width mode)
- Scrollable open tabs switcher displaying live favicons and audio/mute/pinned badges
- Compact Back/Forward/Reload navigation, New Tab, Close Tab, Reopen Closed Tab, and Mute Tab controls
- Dedicated YouTube controls (Play/Pause, -10s / +10s seek, progress scrubber) plus automatic HTML5 video/audio detection on other websites
- 1-tap toggle button between active/background playing media and your Open Tabs scrubber
- Auto-show when switching back to Firefox, configurable from the toolbar popup

All communication stays strictly local on your Mac via Firefox Native Messaging. Zero telemetry or remote tracking. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

release_notes.en-US: Prepare for public AMO listing: migrated built-in site packets from user_scripts to standard static content_scripts and browser.contentScripts.register with static files, removed dynamic code strings, replaced popup UI with zero-dependency DOM code, and added PNG icons.

version.approval_notes: Platform requirement: macOS with Touch Bar hardware and open-source companion binary touchbar-browser-helper (https://github.com/VisionCrizzal/touchbar-addon-new-FF). The extension communicates locally over stdio Native Messaging strictly to render Touch Bar UI items and relay button/scrubber tap events; no shell execution or external network calls occur. Reproducible build (from attached source archive): Node.js v24.14.0, run `npm ci && npm run build`; outputs unminified bundles in ./dist/ via esbuild with zero runtime npm dependencies.
